thread.title: Apple Stock Notches Record High, But Can't Hold Gains

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Apple Stock Notches Record High, But Can't Hold Gains
text:
Shares of consumer electronics giant Apple ( AAPL ) surged to an all-time high on Tuesday after getting a price-target hike from a Wall Street firm, but the stock gave back those gains on growing concerns about the impact of its iPhone battery controversy.
Apple shares dipped 0.5% to close at 176.19   Before it reversed, it had climbed 2.3% to a record high of 179.39.
On Monday, RBC Capital Markets analyst Amit Daryanani reiterated his outperform rating on Apple and raised his price target to 200 from 190.
He sees upside for the company from higher average selling prices for iPhones, continued services growth and the potential for share buybacks from U.S. tax reform.
But Apple continues to face fallout from revelations that it slowed the processors on older iPhones to preserve battery life and prevent sudden crashes. The company is facing multiple class-action lawsuits alleging the iPhone processor throttling was a scheme to encourage people to buy new handsets, a claim Apple vehemently denies.
